title: Rational Verdier duality on a smooth curve over a perfect field
statement:
Let $k$ be a perfect field, let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in $k$, put $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and let $C$ be a smooth separated finite-type $k$-scheme of pure dimension one. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow C$ be a dense open immersion and $i:Z\hookrightarrow C$ its reduced closed complement. Work in the common finite-coefficient-field categories $D^b_c(T,\Lambda)$ of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], for $T=C,U,Z$. For the structure morphism $a_T:T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, put $\omega_T=Ra_T^!\Lambda$ and $D_T(-)=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,\omega_T)$, with exceptional inverse image as right adjoint to compact-support direct image and internal Hom as in [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Write $\Lambda_T(1)$ for the rationalized Kummer system $(\mu_{\ell^n,T})_n$, extended from $\mathbf Q_\ell$ to $\Lambda$.

For $T=C,U,Z$, $D_T$ is an exact contravariant equivalence of $D^b_c(T,\Lambda)$ with itself, with its evaluation biduality $K\xrightarrow{\sim}D_TD_TK$. The smooth dualizing identifications are
$$\omega_C\cong\Lambda_C(1)[2],\qquad \omega_U\cong\Lambda_U(1)[2],\qquad \omega_Z\cong\Lambda_Z.$$
There are natural constructible comparison isomorphisms
$$j^*D_CK\cong D_Uj^*K,\qquad i^*D_CK\cong D_ZRi^!K,$$
where $Ri^!$ is the right adjoint to closed direct image in [prop-sf-localization-all-stages]. All these maps agree with the finite-coefficient-field constructions and commute with scalar extension. If $C,U,Z$ and $i,j$ descend to a finite field, they commute with the Frobenius isomorphisms of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex].
